{{Quote|Hand me the reflek sculptor. I swear there are some welds that weren't here when we got the ship.|Reen Irana, to Eddey Be'ray|<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref>}}
A '''reflek sculptor''' was tool that could be used to perform [[Starship/Legends|starship]] repairs. The devices were long, with multiple heads and included components that beeped. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], a reflek sculptor was kept in a toolbox aboard the [[Suwantek Systems|Suwantek]] [[TL-1200 transport]] ''[[New Ambition]]'', a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] utilized by the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]] and the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]] while conducting operations to combat the spread of the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Tempest (spice)|Tempest]]. While traveling in [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]], Irana asked Be'ray to pass her the reflek sculptor so that she could undertake repairs to the vessel.<ref name="Scourge" />
